item.title: Alert authorities able to catch an alleged scammer red-handed
item.description: PRINCETON, W.Va. — Mercer County Sheriff’s deputies have arrested a man they believe is tied to a wide fraud ring across the nation scamming unsuspecting people. Li Wei, 30, who has a California driver’s license was arrested in Mercer County soon after he was observed taking a box of money from a woman’s home. The post Alert authorities able to catch an alleged scammer red-handed appeared first on WV MetroNews.
